dedupe_keys.name: a tiled multi city urban objects dataset for city scale building energy simulation

description: A tiled multi-city urban objects dataset for city-scale building energy simulation is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Rui Ma, Dongping Fang. City-scale building energy simulation provides a significant reference for planning and urban management. However, large-scale building energy simulation is often not feasible due to the huge amount of computational resources required and the lack of high-precision building models. Here, We developed a tiled multi-city urban objects dataset and a distributed data ontology. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1870684603 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
